summary: Julong Holding Limited, a Cayman Islands exempted company, furnished a Form 6-K on August 18, 2026, reporting unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial results for the six months ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings release with MD&A and exhibits, incorporated by reference into an existing Form F-3 shelf registration. No transaction, merger, tender offer, or strategic event is disclosed. The report reflects ordinary periodic disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisers are mentioned. The filing is routine and does not warrant special-situations classification.
